I have been on a bit of a gaming binge recently, trying out a lot of different things, so I decided to make a recommendations post.

  • Running With Rifles - Insanely fun top down shooter. You play as a soldier and capture various parts of the map until you win. The limit for the amount of soldiers in one battle is 800, so some of the battles are absolutely huge, and very chaotic. Apparently there are a lot of mods for it, including a zombie mod, but I haven't installed any yet. I highly recommend this, it is $15 on Steam at the moment. The only drawback is it only has about 10 maps, though they are quite big. Includes campaign, custom battles and multiplayer.

  • Vampire - The Masquerade - Bloodlines - Someone recommended this one to me in the /v/gaming IRC channel a while ago and I finally got around to playing it. It's an RPG with some great dialogue and a bit of humour that reminds me of Postal at times. I am not very far through the game so I can't elaborate very much on this, but apparently the game changes wildly depending on the type of character and decisions you make. It is from 2004, but it doesn't look that bad, and it might actually be a plus if your computer is a potato.

  • 80 Days - Travel around the world in 80 days during the 1870s in a sort of fictional world. You plot your own path around the globe and try to get back to London as quickly as possible. It can be quite frustrating at times, Russia completely fucked me by detaining me in Vladivostok for 2 weeks, but it has a lot of replay value and is worth getting. I think it was nominated for awards when it came out. There is some resource management - most of your money comes from buying cheap items and selling them in locations where they have a higher price. If you're looking for a more casual game then you might enjoy it.

  • Rimworld - Survival/building game set on a randomly generated alien world. Lots of mods available for this one, some get broken when they release a new version, but the modding community seems to be very active and they release lots of updates. The art style looks extremely similar to Prison Architect, and the building is sort of similar too. The game is still lacking a lot of things, like the ability to customise your own characters, but most of the issues can be straightened out by installing mods to fill in the content/features gaps. I have wasted hours playing earlier versions of this game. Still in alpha.

  • Project Zomboid - Isometric zombie survival. Looting system is brilliant, combat is difficult and its easier to run away most of the time, especially at the beginning. You need to eat, drink, sleep, stay out of the sun, keep yourself entertained to keep morale high, it has everything. You can even build your own bases and stuff, or you can just squat in someone's house and eat all their food. I heard that development on this game has stopped because someone stole the developers laptop that had two years of work on it or something. Even if it doesn't get any updates, I would still get it as it is, it's fun and quite challenging.

  • Kingdom New Lands - This is a recent update for Kingdom. It's kind of a weird one, it's a sidescroller where you can't do anything other than give money to your peasants and get them to build shit or fight these weird demon things that come from the woods to get your money. I played the original Kingdom game once and forgot about it because there is hardly any gameplay involved at all. The update does have some more stuff in it, but its still a very casual game. It's the sort of thing that's good to play for half an hour if you're listening to music or a podcast or something.

  • Jazzpunk - I don't even know man. Just get it.

Other games you should check out but I'm too lazy to describe fully:

  • Okhlos - Came out today, kill Greek gods with an angry mob that follows you around.
  • Zombie Night Terror - Lemmings, but with zombies.
  • Satellite Reign
  • Oxenfree
  • Rodina - Space shooter/exploration game with unbelievable scale. Think it might still be in alpha.
  • Aviary Attorney - Ace Attorney, but with birds.
  • Death Road To Canada
  • Samarost 3
  • Sheltered
  • Sunless Sea
  • Human: Fall Flat
Recommendations: Some games I've been playing recently
